title: Visual field test
what: A machine checks how wide you can see to the sides. You look at the center and press a button when you notice a flash.
why: For glaucoma or suspected glaucoma, retina and nerve conditions, and after injuries.
duration: usually 10 to 30 minutes for both eyes; results are often ready right away
tell_doctor: If you have glaucoma or it is suspected
If you had this test before
What eye drops and medicines you use

prepare.title: Rest
prepare.text: Get a good night's sleep. Focus matters for an accurate result.

prepare.title: Glasses
prepare.text: Bring your glasses, especially reading glasses.

steps: One eye is covered with a patch
You rest your chin on a stand and look at a center point
Faint flashes appear in different places
When you see a flash, you press the button
Do not search for flashes with your eyes. Keep looking at the center
Then the same is done for the other eye
feel: It can be tiring and dull. You can ask for a break
You will miss some flashes. That is how the test works
after: The doctor will compare the result with past ones and tell you what is next

faq.q: I missed a lot of flashes. Is that bad?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The machine also shows very faint flashes on purpose.
To see if your vision changes over time, especially with glaucoma.

reminders.text: Visual field test tomorrow. Get a good night's sleep and bring your glasses.
